# BrainScroll

> BrainScroll is a daily learning app for iPhone. It turns a few minutes a day into real knowledge, one level at a time: short lessons, smart review so it sticks, and weekly leagues. Free to learn, with no ads.

## How it works

- Each level is a few short learning cards that make one idea click, then three questions.
- Your first try earns the XP. Miss a question and you see the card that explains it, then try again until it's yours.
- Smart review brings ideas back just before you'd forget them.
- Every level you clear raises your brain level. Climb a skill tree from Level 1 to 100 to master it and earn its gold star, with trophies along the way and a streak on the days you learn.
- Add friends with a link or a username. Every week you join a league of up to 20 learners, in tiers from Quartz up to the Crown. Hearts are the only reaction: no chat or comments.

## What you can learn

26 skill trees, 100 levels each:

- History: Ancient Egypt, Ancient Greece, Ancient Rome, The Middle Ages, US History
- Science: The Animal Kingdom, Astronomy, Chemistry, The Human Body
- Geography: Earth, Weather & Climate; The Oceans; World Geography
- Arts & Culture: Architecture, Art History, Film & TV, Literature, Music
- How the World Works: How Money Works, Computers & the Internet, Everyday Technology, How Government Works
- Mind & Reasoning: Logic & Critical Thinking, Philosophy, Probability & Statistics, Psychology, World Religions

## Price

Every subject is free, with new levels every day and review always open. Unlimited, an optional subscription, removes the daily limit for people who want more in one sitting. No ads, no lives, nothing locked behind a paywall.
